answers.rationale: A best matches the repeated family-tournament priorities: confirmed two queens, free parking, included early breakfast, and practical dinner access, while remaining only 9 minutes from the expo center. The small price premium over the team block is justified by avoiding an unverified breakfast arrangement before a Saturday morning match.

Keep the block hotel. When a reimbursable conference hotel is directly connected to required registration and sessions, the user repeatedly prioritizes protected logistics over included breakfast or a modest rate difference. Indoor access is especially valuable in January while carrying a laptop and printed materials without a car.

A protects the fixed 7:30 hosted breakfast with the shortest drive, free parking, and reliable late-arrival dinner options. Because breakfast is hosted at the meeting, included hotel breakfast has little value; the user's history favors proximity to the fixed early event over hotel breakfast when the two conflict.

A is the clear late-fair choice: it is closest to both the 8:45 p.m. fair finish and Tuesday's school visit, includes free parking, and has an on-site late-food solution. With Tuesday not starting until 10:00 a.m., breakfast inclusion does not outweigh avoiding late driving and preserving a simple next morning.
